findings.description: Added useEffect to sync marketData.priceYoYChange/rentYoYChange to scenarioData defaults. Uses scenarioModified flag to prevent overwriting user choices - this is the correct pattern for smart defaults.
Now properly uses expectedMonthlyRent (user input) with fallback to marketData.averageRent. Clear UI indicators show data source (User vs Database icon).

Added scenarioData prop and useEffect to sync priceGrowthRate/rentGrowthRate as overrides. The priceGrowthRateOverride/rentGrowthRateOverride pattern ensures user scenario takes precedence over macro model.
Now displays market YoY rates as reference text next to input fields. Helps users understand what market data suggests while allowing manual override.
purchasePrice prop is now meaningfully used - shows 'Purchase vs Current Value' comparison with gain/loss percentage. Only displays when both values are available.
Calculator changes ensure 'sell now' semantics are correct - uses current market price without growth rate. Added initialInvestment (down payment) and pureProfit fields for clearer accounting.
Chart now uses pureProfit for consistency with card totals. Year 0 correctly shows pure profit (no reinvestment yet), subsequent years add reinvestment returns.

summary: All 4 original data flow issues have been properly addressed: (1) Rent source is now consistent - PredictionPanel uses expectedMonthlyRent with fallback to market data; (2) scenarioData.priceGrowthRate/rentGrowthRate are now synced to prediction via usePrediction hook; (3) Market YoY data is used as smart defaults for scenario assumptions; (4) purchasePrice is now meaningfully used for purchase-vs-current comparison. Build passes with 0 TypeScript errors. Additional fixes for chart/card consistency were also included.
